staticText: Scholarship discovery and private shortlist tool. Use source-linked live opportunities when available; curated fallback cards are explicitly current-cycle unverified and must be confirmed on the provider page. Shortlist relevance is not eligibility, award probability or admissions advice. Applicant-country and grade filters stay disabled when the feed does not structure those requirements consistently. Users must confirm eligibility, deadlines, funding, documents and application routes with each provider.
